name: bus-world-model-feasibility-v1
scope: One-step nonterminal model feasibility, not MC-WM control performance
selector: Minimum mean six-head loss on calibration block 1208; residual versus direct only
diagnostic_baseline: Constant target-fit marginal predictor, not eligible for model-family selection
limitations: No policy updates, imagined rollouts, Bellman correction, or target online training.
Terminal tails are audited separately, not fitted by this nonterminal pilot.
Only two model-test environment blocks; not independent control confirmation.
Neural output residual is a bus interface pilot, not the full sparse MC-WM adapter.
Prior H2O initializers saw all ten blocks and are not reused.
